name: board game rules
content_styles: Write like a board game rulebook about the topic. A game title, an objective, setup, turn structure, and a 'winning' section. Voice is dry, precise, and absurdly serious about nonsense rules.
Write like a party game instruction card. A setup, a 'how to play' section, a scoring section, and a 'house rules' note. Voice is casual and fun.
Write like a strategy game manual. A game title, an objective, a setup, a turn structure, a 'strategy tips' section, and a 'winning' section. Voice is analytical and confident.
layouts: Build a rulebook: a cover header, an objective section, a setup section, a turn structure, and a 'winning' section. One continuous document with clear sections.
Build an instruction card: a header, a setup, a 'how to play' section, a scoring section, and a 'house rules' note. One continuous card.
Build a strategy manual: a cover header, an objective, a setup, a turn structure, a 'strategy tips' section, and a 'winning' section. One continuous document.
themes: Rulebook look: white background, black text, bold section headings, a single accent color, and a clean sans-serif. Unified and precise.
Party game look: bright background, bold colors, playful headings, and a fun sans-serif. Unified and festive.
Strategy look: dark background, gold accents, bold headings, and a serious sans-serif. Unified and analytical.

elements.name: objective
elements.content: OBJECTIVE: [the absurd objective of the game]

elements.name: player_count
elements.content: PLAYERS: [a player count and age range]

visual_style: VISUAL: precise rulebook. White background, black text, bold section headings, a single accent color, bordered boxes, and a clean sans-serif.
